Our team of professionals is fully trained and committed to providing purpose built storage, premium concierge services for our Members. | We offer end-to-end solutions to fuel your passion for driving and collecting including storage and maintenance, sales, events, and networking. | What types of Membership are available at One Drivers Club? | Membership is designed for automotive enthusiasts who value connection, access, and experiences, not just a place for vehicles. We offer three types of membership including a Social Membership and two types of Parking Memberships: Annual (12 months) or Seasonal (6 months minimum). | Annual and Seasonal Parking Members enjoy full access to the clubhouse, priority participation in social events and programs, and curated services for all vehicle types, including motorcycles. | All Members have access to the clubhouse and storage facilities during regular business hours, and are encouraged to bring friends and family. Additionally, as a Member you are invited and have access to events both at the One Drivers Club facilities and with our event partners. | Who is One Drivers Club? | One Drivers Club is privately owned by a select group of individuals. Originally founded as Collectors Car Garage and launched in Bedford Hills, NY, over 20 years ago, the company and its team have grown to include locations in Chicago, Palm Beach, and Seattle. | One Drivers Club specializes in premier concierge storage and collection management, catering to over 500 Members, overseeing and caring for over 1,200 vehicles. Our Members community enjoys numerous drives and special events every year. We anticipate expanding in new markets and continuing to care for each vehicle uniquely. | What are the facilities like? Are they safe and secure? | One Drivers Club facilities are selected with the focus of choosing private, convenient, and safe locations, customizing each for optimal vehicle storage to ensure the best care and oversight. All of our properties feature climate controlled environments and 24/7 camera monitoring supplemented by physical and third-party security. | How do you care for the cars that are stored? | Our team brings over 20 years of expertise in luxury car storage. We consistently undertake facility and vehicle checks to ensure their conditions remain at the highest standards, ensuring unexpected leaks or any emerging problems have not arisen. | Our on-site staff coordinates all desired or required maintenance with our network of specialists—from routine check-up to specialized restoration work. We work with each Member to create and maintain the best plan to accommodate requests on a 1:1 basis. | How does parking my car work? | Most of our facilities operate with a “valet” parking model, where vehicles are parked by trained staff with a minimum of two staffers undertaking any movement within the facility. Our Seattle facility operates as a self-park Club with 24/7 access and was built to accommodate that Member preference. We kindly request 24 hours notice to prepare your vehicle for pick-up, but staff is available to accommodate shorter lead time requests. | May I request a self-parking spot? | In locations that have been designed to accommodate self-parking, including 24/7 access, Members are able to request that option. With anytime access and assigned self-parking spots, Members are able to enter and exit the facility at their convenience. Our Seattle location has been uniquely fitted to offer this for a majority of Members. Other locations will require advance notice to place cars in the dedicated spots for self-pick-up and drop-off. | Do you arrange for pick-up and drop-off? | Yes, we are always available to arrange for drop-off and pick-up at your convenience. Vehicles may either be driven by our expert staff or moved by one of our trusted partners. Members can specify the method of transport, whether it be enclosed, open, or driven. | What if I need to get my car on short notice? | While we appreciate requests to be made at least 24 hours in advance, all our locations are staffed during business hours and can accommodate last-minute requests. Please call, email, or text your dedicated facility to ensure all arrangements can be made. | May I store different cars in the same space? | Yes, as a Member of One Drivers Club, you are allocated space(s) within the facility based on your anticipated collection needs. You are welcome to alternate any and all of your vehicles to accommodate different driving interests. Typically, Members will rotate vehicles on a regular basis within a facility, including their higher mileage ”daily driver” vehicles. | May I move my vehicle storage from one location to another? | Based on space availability, we are glad to accommodate collections across multiple locations in our network and are available to help manage any transportation needs between locations. | How do you maintain and balance the temperature and environment for the vehicles? | Each facility features climate controls to ensure the condition of your vehicle. We continuously work to perfect the ideal storage conditions for vintage and collectible vehicles. Decades specializing in premier storage and vehicle collection and operations management enable us to prepare and deliver for any environment scenario. | How do you keep low-use vehicles’ batteries charged and in good condition? Battery tenders? | Each vehicle has access to outlet(s) to provide electricity for battery maintenance. If you do not have a battery tender, we highly recommend using one. They are available in our inventory on site for purchase should you elect that route. | Do you offer electric vehicle charging? | We offer electric vehicle charging at Palm Beach and Seattle. We can arrange for electric charging at our other locations. As we continue to enhance our facilities, we are adding this capability into site planning. | What service work do you perform? | As the premier collection management and storage solution, we are here to make your vehicle ownership as fulfilling as possible. Our services include all that you or your vehicle might need, from a wash or detail to full restoration management. Depending on your request and your location, our in-house team completes the services or we leverage our network of specialist partners. For example, our Palm Beach location features a service shop with full-time trained mechanics. Other locations might partner with regional specialists to complete all service requests. | How do your service, maintenance, and restoration offerings work? | All work is performed by our expert network of insured, trusted service professionals. In select locations, our factory-trained mechanics will perform services. Our established network of partners ensures that we only work with those best skilled for each specific job or issue. | Can you help me repair/restore my vehicle? | Each location team is available and highly trained to coordinate all types of repairs and restoration work for your vehicle. One Drivers Club has an established network of mechanics and craftsmen ready to care for your car with specialized skills, highest quality, and personalized service. | How do you charge for service work? | Services are billed at cost plus a service fee. All costs and fees are disclosed and agreed upon prior to beginning work. Provider receipts are provided. | How much is the service fee for coordinating maintenance or other work? | A service fee is predetermined and estimated as a percentage of work. The percentage is a sliding scale based on the gross amount of the provider’s invoice. Our facility managers are available to provide estimates for desired work. | What types of programs and events does One Drivers Club offer? | As part of a full calendar of events, each of our clubhouses hosts seasonal rallies, preview opportunities with dealerships, test drives of new models, and Member drives. Please contact our local facility manager to learn more. | May I bring guests to events at the clubhouse? | Guests are welcome when accompanied by a Member. Select events may be exclusive to Members and will be communicated as such in advance. | May I host events at the facilities? | Yes, the clubhouse and facilities are available to host private events. Please contact your facility manager for details and costing. | Are events private? | Exclusive to Members and their guests, events are private and by invitation only. | Do you charge for social events? | Depending on the event and club location, a nominal fee may be charged when applicable. Fees will be communicated in advance across all materials. | What sales and acquisition services does One Drivers Club provide? | One Drivers Club acts as a trusted advisor to guide your collection, whether you are acquiring a new asset or maximizing the value of a vehicle you wish to sell. Our team of automotive experts provides collection direction, market insight, and targeted sourcing to help you buy or sell vehicles with complete confidence. | Are you a licensed dealer? | Yes, One Drivers Club is a licensed dealer. As part of our collection management solution, we provide a trusted, specialized, and seamless Sales solution for Members across locations. Local facility managers can introduce you to the full breadth of our Sales offering, ranging from valuation services and marketing to transaction support. | How do you charge for your sales services? | Ranging from a set percentage to a base fee, plus increments over the agreed sales floor prices, One Drivers Club works directly and transparently with owners to communicate options at the onset of the consignment. | Do I need to be a Member of One Drivers Club to take advantage of the sales and collection management services? | No, you do not. Non-Members may also take advantage of our Sales solution. Active Members receive preferred pricing. Commission fees for Non-Members apply at a premium. | What’s included in the monthly charge? | Membership and storage are charged on a monthly basis and are inclusive of all applicable taxes.
